decision: For the exact GUM original-package native-center contacts only, classify the two retained USA-labelled operand identities as Guam administrative context. The retained official Census 2018 state-equivalent row identifies Guam (GEOID 66), and county-equivalent row identifies Guam (GEOID 66010); the retained Census 2021 County Subdivisions query joins all 19 named geoBoundaries GUM ADM2 members to exact Guam subdivision BASENAME values under STATE 66 / COUNTY 010. Accordingly, exact contacts with these two named Guam operands are contextual and do not operate as foreign territorial exclusions for these exact member/key incidences. This is a narrow source-applicability interpretation for this package, not a conclusion about sovereignty, title, international law, current authority, geometry equality, or other USA operands.

census_2021_county_subdivisions.join_method: Exact shapeName to BASENAME join, without normalization or geometric comparison. Full Census query returned 20 features; 19 named municipalities join exactly; one water-only undefined subdivision is retained explicitly, not discarded or adopted.

geoBoundaries_operand_source_metadata.feature_sources: Complete retained gb:USA:ADM1 and gb:USA:ADM2 product pins at the original corpus baseline.

limits: The Census attributes establish the exact named administrative hierarchy represented in the retained Census products, not sovereignty, title, external legal validity, or exact boundary equivalence to geoBoundaries polygons.
The 19 named GUM feature identities are joined by exact name and stable shapeID to Census BASENAME and GEOID; no geometry comparison was performed.
The 20th Census row is an undefined water-only record and is retained as unmatched, not adopted as a municipality.

This decision applies only to exact retained interior native-center contact incidences with the two Guam operands and the listed GUM members. It does not blanket-suppress USA families or resolve any non-Guam operand.
Source-catalogue labels/vintage/license fields are retained metadata claims, not independent upstream rights validation or proof of present applicability.
The GUM physical comparison is whole-target and includes adverse reconstruction flags; it does not provide per-key physical clearance or current land/water truth.
No owner, native assignment, repair, acceptance, or credit is changed or asserted by this contextualization.
